title: AetherSX2 VS NetherSX2: Head to Head Comparison | Which PS2 Emulator is Best?
summary: DroidSX2 Gamer compares AetherSX2 and NetherSX2 on the same Snapdragon 680 phone, using a 6 GB Adreno 610 baseline and linked per-game settings to keep the fork comparison tied to constrained hardware.

blocks.text: The five-minute head-to-head fixes the phone at Snapdragon 680, Adreno 610, 6 GB RAM and 128 GB storage before showing both emulator branches in PS2 games. Separate settings videos for God of War II and Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 3 reveal that each side may have been tuned rather than judged only on defaults. That matters because NetherSX2 inherits an AetherSX2 base and changes around it; a fair comparison should isolate build and configuration instead of treating the names as unrelated engines.

The description mistakenly calls the pair PSP emulators, and it does not state exact APK versions, driver, resolution, thermal state, capture method or a synchronized scene list. Linked “best settings” can also create asymmetric conditions if different speed hacks or per-game patches are active. Verify packages from trusted project channels, avoid redistributed modified APKs, and reproduce the same save state under matched options. This clip documents one low-power phone comparison, not a permanent ranking between every AetherSX2 and NetherSX2 release.
